reviews.author: Niyati J.
reviews.title: Repaired my dry & damaged skin
reviews.body: this has been my best investment before winter...it is super lightweight and it actually feels like its going deep into my skin. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rutuja K
reviews.title: Only soft skin!
reviews.body: I had really dry snake type skin...needed to reapply lotion every 3-4 hours...this is the first one i have used that has properly kept my skin soft and hydrated for so long...i was afraid it would be sticky but it is perfect for my skin!

reviews.author: Parichita D
reviews.title: My dry skin loves it
reviews.body: Mere legs itne dry hai ki wo snake skin texture aata hai and no lotion has managed to solve it. But this one was really diff. itna deeply nourishing hai ye, nd long lasting hai iska moisturisation...Love it

reviews.author: Smita S
reviews.title: So good
reviews.body: I was so fed up of my dry skin that i was literally applying oil on my skin hoping it would keep it hydrated. Tried this as a last resort and im so impressed with the results, my skin feels so smooth and soft. i am never going back to my old lotion from now on.
